Resolves #21501

The two portal docs specs no longer parse the class index inside their `beforeAll`. A new step before `Run e2e (engine tier)` generates `docs/output` in each shard whose specs call the new `ensureDocsOutput()` helper (two of fifteen today) and sets `NEO_DOCS_OUTPUT_READY`, so the helper skips the parse. That parse took 11–59 s, and it now sits outside both the run step's six-minute ceiling and the planner's per-file costs. The hook's 60 s timeout goes with it. Locally nothing sets the flag, and the specs generate the index as before.

Evidence: L2 (this PR's own e2e run executes the new step in the docs specs' shards; both helper paths ran locally) → L2 required (AC-1 is the recorded measurement; AC-2 needs at least eight full runs after merge, under Post-Merge Validation).

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | Outside CI: [the measurement on #21501](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21501#issuecomment-7018590199). Over 32 runs the hook gap was 11–59 s while the tests varied 1.54× and 1.68×. Every other file's gap is 0.0–0.4 s, and the same predecessor specs gave 12.5 s and 58.6 s. |
| AC-2 | Its first clause holds on this PR's own run: the hook gaps were 0.1 s and 0.2 s (Test Evidence). Its spread across at least eight full runs is post-merge. |

## Deltas from ticket
- **The parse moves, it isn't removed.** The measured cause is the runner's speed on the parse, which none of the ticket's candidates (a condition wait, a warm-up, a smaller fixture) remove. A cache of `docs/output` keyed on its inputs would skip it on matching runs; that is a follow-up only if the runner time matters.
- **The duration table** still plans the two files at 34.8 s and 42.6 s. Their rows shrink at the next rebuild, which is #21493's scope; until then the planner over-plans, the safe direction.
- **CI jobs: +0.** One step in the existing e2e job, run only in shards whose specs need it.
- **The step repeats the run step's shard selection** rather than moving it: `E2eCiSelection.spec.mjs` pins that line in the run step. If the two drift, a spec generates the index itself.

## Test Evidence
- **This PR's e2e run** (`44593475420`): the step generated the index only in shards 12 (24 s) and 13 (13 s), and finished in under a second in the other 13. `DocsClassRoutes`' hook gap was 0.1 s and `DocsMixinsNL`'s 0.2 s, against 11–59 s before.
- **Shard detection**, under bash like the step, across the full tier's 15 shards: only shards 12 and 13 generate, for `DocsClassRoutes` and `DocsMixinsNL`.
- **Both specs, helper generating** (no flag): 9 passed, 38.8 s.
- **Both specs with `NEO_DOCS_OUTPUT_READY=true`:** 9 passed, 15.9 s, and `docs/output/structure.json` keeps its mtime, so nothing regenerated.
- **Selection:** a change to `test/playwright/util/docsOutput.mjs` selects both docs specs through the reach map.
- `agent-preflight`: not hosted here; class declared zero-delta (`ci`).

## Post-Merge Validation
- [x] AC-2: across at least eight full runs, each docs spec's hook gap stays under 1 s and its max/min stays below 2, measured with the ticket's log split. ([45 runs](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21506#issuecomment-7027373635))
- [x] The `Generate the Docs class index` step's time in those runs is recorded beside it, so the moved cost stays visible. ([recorded](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21506#issuecomment-7027373635))

### 🔬 Depth Floor

**Challenge**: A short manual dispatch filter that Playwright can resolve can miss the pre-generation scan, which reads paths from the checkout. The shared hook then generates the index in the dispatch run. This is outside AC-2's full-run sample and preserves execution for that mode.

**Findings:** Both full-tier steps use the same selector inputs. The setup step with a failed generator exits before publishing `NEO_DOCS_OUTPUT_READY`. The helper calls generation from the repository root when the flag is absent and skips the call when it is true.
